question: L, M, N, O, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only one person sits between N and Q when counted from the left of Q. S sits third to the right of R. L sits third to the left of M. S sits to the immediate right of L. O is not an immediate neighbour of L. How many people sit between O and Q when counted from the right of O?
solution:
Given: L, M, N, O, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1) Only one person sits between N and Q when counted from the left of Q.

2) S sits third to the right of R.

3) L sits third to the left of M.
